meta.source: NOAA-OWP HAND FIM, HUC 12070104 branch 3125000011 — rem_zeroed_masked + hydroTable, 10 m, CC BY 4.0 via the Texas Pin2Flood archive
meta.method: per-reach stage from the hydrotable SRC at the mainstem discharge the observed Richmond rating gives for the band's stage; a cell is wet when its HAND is below its own reach's stage

validation.domain: the study corridor, with the radar extent clipped to it — the polygon reaches further upstream than the corridor does
validation.peak_is_not_like_for_like: the image was taken at 49.40 ft; the crest three days later was 54.74 ft, so comparing the crest to it charges the map for water the image could never have shown
validation.reading: an upper bound with a measured bias: at the one observed stage this maps 2.3x the radar's area, with recall 0.78 and precision 0.34. The radar is a water edge under a forested floodplain, which C-band under-maps, and HAND treats every low cell as connected to its channel. Use the outline, not the waterline.

limits: steady state: the same discharge on every mainstem reach, no wave travel time
no backwater: HAND's level-pool assumption per reach
no connectivity test across catchments (HAND's known over-prediction)
one observation, three days before the crest, in a forested floodplain
